subject.title: fix(macos): Settings remote test hides gateway auth recovery steps

question: Should this visible macOS Settings auth-recovery change require redacted real UI proof before merge, or will maintainers provide/accept an explicit proof override?
rationale: The code path is source-backed and tested, but the PR changes visible Settings recovery UI and the contributor explicitly reports no real macOS UI proof.

options.title: Require redacted Settings proof
options.body: Ask for a screenshot or short recording showing Settings Test remote rendering the structured auth recovery prompt after an auth failure, with private details redacted.

options.title: Accept proof override
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly override the real-behavior proof gate after separately verifying the refreshed macOS Settings UI path.

recommendation.title: Require redacted Settings proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a screenshot or short recording showing Settings Test remote rendering the structured auth recovery prompt after an auth failure, with private details redacted.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work on the same macOS remote gateway probe boundary makes steipete the best available proof-sufficiency owner from the inspected history.
